question: Who should take consent to fill in my case management paperwork?

response.label: Official SOP
response.answer: The case worker seeks consent and completes case management forms.
response.speech_text: The case worker seeks consent and completes case management forms.
response.evidence: No Position Primary responsibilities Secondary responsibilities 2 Case workers Case workers will have the follow- ing responsibilities: • Documentation of case history of survivor • Seek consent and fill out all case management forms • Assess needs of survivor (immediate safety needs, medical needs, psychosocial needs) and gather basic information • Inform survivor about available services (health, mental health, justice, safety) • Develop case action plan and work with survivor to identify interventions to address their needs • Connect survivor to relevant services and support in accessing services in collaboration with the Centre Administrator • Support survivor in preparing a safety plan to ensure their safety and security • Followup with survivor to assess status of survivor’s situa- tion • Ensure case closure in a safe and supportive environment Case worker will support the Centre Administrator in: · Coordinating with relevant services for survivors · Undertaking outreach activ- ities · She will seek support of the Centre Adminis - trator for review of the case action plan.

question: How many years must someone have worked on women's issues to apply as an OSC case worker?

response.speech_text: A case worker needs at least three years of relevant experience in a government or nongovernmental project or programme working on women’s issues.

question: Does the centre need a space with toys or books for children who accompany survivors?
